queries.name: TaskExecutionCorrectionPreview
returns: current outcome revision/event or exact absence
rules: pure stable-snapshot query; supplied Task/execution/target revisions must exact-match current authority or the preview fails stale rather than guessing a review context
execution authority must reconcile projection revision/event count/final-event identity to one contiguous execution_revision chain before a fingerprint can be issued

the target must be an owned non-correction base execution event at exactly target_execution_revision and must remain current-effective after all corrections through execution_revision; an already withdrawn target is not eligible

withdraw is not an authorizing path for rfc_terminal_terminate or source_terminal_consequence because those terminal facts are bound to separate governed RFC/source-terminal decisions; replacing their effective instant may be reviewed only while the terminal base event remains effective and resulting chronology is valid
simulate the requested correction against complete immutable execution history and require a valid fold; correction never trusts a caller-computed state or aggregate

fingerprint binds schema/version, task_id/task_revision, execution_revision plus projection state/instants/last_event_id, exact target event identity/revision/kind/original effective instant, its current-effective instant after prior corrections, requested action/replacement/reason, current outcome exact absence or revision/current-event/outcome/reason/reviewed_at, resulting folded execution state/instants and outcome_invalidation_required

fingerprint serialization uses LLD-01 strict canonical JSON under schema SOMA_TASK_EXECUTION_CORRECTION_REVIEW_V1 and lowercase SHA-256; timestamps and UUID lexical order never provide mutation chronology
outcome_invalidation_required is true only when a current reviewed outcome that is presently valid would cease to satisfy the Task outcome acceptance matrix under the simulated corrected execution
preview has no receipt, audit, domain revision, execution/outcome mutation, Objective rebuild or external effect

queries.name: TaskOutcomeReviewPreview
input: outcome_revision where 0 means exact outcome-history/current absence
returns: current outcome revision/event or exact absence
rules: pure stable-snapshot query; supplied Task/execution/outcome revisions and current-outcome identity must exact-match current authority or return TASK_STALE rather than guessing a review context; projection/history disagreement fails closed
execution authority is folded strictly by contiguous execution_revision; outcome authority is absent only when both task_outcome_current and task_outcome_events are absent
positive outcome authority must be one linear append-only chain whose current revision equals owned event count and whose current event is the unique chain tip
requested outcome is checked against the current corrected execution acceptance matrix; caller-provided outcome currentness is never trusted

fingerprint binds schema/version, task_id/task_revision, execution revision/projection/last_event_id and folded state/instants, current outcome exact absence or revision/current-event/outcome/reason/reviewed_at, requested outcome and normalized reason
fingerprint serialization uses LLD-01 strict canonical JSON under schema SOMA_TASK_OUTCOME_REVIEW_V1 and lowercase SHA-256

semantic_no_change is true only when the exact current reviewed outcome remains valid and both requested outcome and normalized reason exactly equal the current event; any different current reviewed outcome requires CorrectTaskOutcome rather than overwrite
preview has no receipt, audit, domain revision, history append, Objective rebuild or external effect

queries.name: TaskOutcomeCorrectionPreview
rules: pure stable-snapshot query; exact Task/execution/current-outcome revision and current event identity are mandatory; supplied freshness mismatch returns TASK_STALE rather than generating a fingerprint for different authority
positive outcome authority must reconcile to one linear append-only chain before preview; current revision equals event count/chain length and current_outcome_event_id is the exact tip
replacement outcome is checked against current corrected execution evidence and never against caller-computed execution state

fingerprint binds schema/version, task_id/task_revision, exact execution revision/projection/last_event_id and folded state/instants, exact current outcome revision/event/outcome/reason/reviewed_at, replacement outcome and normalized reason
fingerprint serialization uses LLD-01 strict canonical JSON under schema SOMA_TASK_OUTCOME_CORRECTION_REVIEW_V1 and lowercase SHA-256

semantic_no_change is true only when replacement outcome and normalized reason exactly equal the current event under the exact fingerprint; otherwise accepted correction must append against that exact tip
preview has no receipt, audit, domain revision, history append, Objective rebuild or external effect
